switch.$description: v0.6 — Switch (binary toggle). Distinct from Toggle (button-style on/off). Off = sunken track. On = lime track + thumb slides right.

track.$description: The pill-shaped background. Sized to fit a 16 px thumb with 2 px padding on each side.

width.$description: Switch-specific. Computed: thumb (16) + travel (16) + padding (2 + 2) = 36 px. Off-grid relative to the 4-multiple primitive scale, hence inline.

thumb.$description: The circle that slides between off and on. Lifts subtly on press with a 2 px shadow.

on.$description: Near-black-green so it reads on lime.

translateOn.$description: 16 px slide. Track width (36) − thumb width (16) − padding gap (4) = 16.
